explication: RR is a Synology DSM bootloader preinstallation and recovery environment for x86/x64 machines. The principal workflow is: a user boots the prepared media, RR initializes hardware and configuration, presents its management menu, and produces or launches a patched DSM-compatible boot environment. Compilation obtains model, version, PAT, addon, and module data from online sources. The graph also shows Proxmox installation and Docker/QEMU usage. Some shell orchestration is inferred only from filenames because those implementations were not sampled.
